eval_dimensions.name: Phase 3 Disposition Gate on Non-Empty Delta
eval_dimensions.description: When the Phase 3 delta report flags at least one rule shape as ineffective, the skill fires AskUserQuestion (File upstream issue / Save report only / Discard) before doing anything with the report — it never files or discards automatically.

eval_dimensions.name: Empty Delta Skips the Gate
eval_dimensions.description: When the delta report finds no ineffective rule shapes, Phase 3 does not fire AskUserQuestion — there is nothing to disposition.

eval_dimensions.name: Phase 4 Restore Runs Unconditionally
eval_dimensions.description: Settings are restored via `dev10x permission investigate restore` regardless of which Phase 3 disposition was chosen, and even when an earlier phase fails or errors.

evals.name: A non-empty delta fires AskUserQuestion before any report action
evals.description: When `dev10x permission investigate delta` reports at least one ineffective rule shape, the skill must ask before filing or discarding the report.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion fires with 'File upstream issue (Recommended)' / 'Save report only' / 'Discard' options
No inline 'should I file this upstream?' text substitutes for the widget
mcp__plugin_Dev10x_cli__issue_create is NOT called before the gate resolves

evals.name: Selecting 'File upstream issue' invokes issue_create with the report body
evals.description: When the user selects the recommended option, the skill invokes the issue-creation MCP tool with the matrix/delta report as the body, labeled permission-friction and from-investigator.

assertions.signal: issue_create is invoked with labels including permission-friction and from-investigator, body from report.md

evals.name: Empty delta skips Phase 3's AskUserQuestion entirely
evals.description: When the delta report finds zero ineffective rule shapes, Phase 3 proceeds directly to Phase 4 without firing AskUserQuestion.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion is NOT called when the delta report is empty; the skill proceeds directly to Phase 4 restore

evals.name: Restore still runs after the user picks Discard
evals.description: Even when the user selects Discard at the Phase 3 gate, Phase 4 restore runs — settings are never left mutated.

assertions.signal: `uv run dev10x permission investigate restore` runs after Discard is selected

evals.name: Restore runs even when an earlier phase errors
evals.description: If Phase 1 or Phase 2 fails partway through (e.g., a subagent probe errors), Phase 4 restore still executes rather than leaving mutated settings in place.

assertions.signal: `dev10x permission investigate restore` runs even after a Phase 1/2 failure; settings.local.json is not left in the mutated fixture state

trigger_evals.description: Queries that should/should-not trigger the permission-investigator skill

should_trigger.rationale: Direct invocation — runs the full matrix investigation

should_trigger.query: permission prompts are still appearing after plugin-maintenance cleanup, can you figure out why
should_trigger.rationale: Persistent friction after cleanup — the core use case

should_not_trigger.query: add this one rule to settings.local.json
should_not_trigger.rationale: Ad-hoc single-rule debugging — write it directly and reload instead

should_not_trigger.query: run plugin maintenance to fix my permissions
